name: Idli with Sambar and Coconut Chutney
instructions: Steam idli batter in moulds for 10-12 min. Serve with warm sambar and coconut chutney.

name: Masala Dosa with Coconut Chutney
instructions: Spread dosa batter on hot griddle, fill with spiced potato, fold and serve with chutney.

name: Paneer Paratha with Greek Yogurt
instructions: Knead atta dough, stuff with spiced paneer, roll and cook on griddle with ghee. Serve with yogurt.

name: Oats and Mixed Berry Porridge
instructions: Cook oats in water or plant milk for 5 min. Top with mixed berries and a sprinkle of chia seeds.

name: Chia Seed Pudding with Banana and Almond Butter
instructions: Mix chia seeds with almond milk, refrigerate overnight. Top with sliced banana and almond butter.

name: Smoothie Bowl with Flax Seeds and Mixed Berries
instructions: Blend berries with banana until thick. Pour into bowl. Top with flax seeds and more berries.

name: Avocado Toast with Hemp Seeds
instructions: Toast whole wheat pita. Mash avocado, spread on toast. Sprinkle hemp seeds and sliced tomato.

name: Greek Yogurt Parfait with Berries and Walnuts
instructions: Layer yogurt with mixed berries and crushed walnuts. Drizzle with honey if desired.

name: Scrambled Tofu with Kale and Red Pepper
instructions: Crumble tofu and stir-fry with kale, red pepper, garlic, and turmeric until cooked through.

name: Masala Omelette with Spinach
instructions: Beat eggs with turmeric, chili, and onion. Cook in pan with spinach until set.

name: Cottage Cheese and Berry Bowl
instructions: Scoop cottage cheese into bowl. Top with mixed berries and a drizzle of flax seeds.

name: Oat Bran Porridge with Apple and Almond Butter
instructions: Cook oat bran in water for 5 min. Stir in sliced apple and top with almond butter.

name: Tempeh and Avocado Breakfast Bowl
instructions: Slice and pan-fry tempeh until golden. Serve over avocado mash with sliced tomato.

name: Edamame and Brown Rice Breakfast Bowl
instructions: Warm brown rice and edamame. Drizzle with olive oil, season with salt and sesame seeds.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Smoothie
instructions: Blend banana, peanut butter, whole milk (or plant milk), and a pinch of flax seeds.

name: Roti with Greek Yogurt and Avocado
instructions: Make fresh rotis with atta. Serve with Greek yogurt and sliced avocado.

name: Moong Dal Cheela (Lentil Pancake)
instructions: Blend soaked moong dal to batter, add spices, cook on griddle. Serve with coconut chutney.

name: Halloumi and Vegetable Breakfast Skillet
instructions: Pan-fry halloumi slices until golden. Sauté zucchini, tomato, red pepper. Serve together.

name: Miso Soup with Tofu and Seaweed
instructions: Dissolve miso paste in warm water. Add tofu cubes, seaweed, and green onions.

name: Ricotta Toast with Mixed Berries
instructions: Toast pita bread, spread ricotta generously, top with fresh mixed berries.

name: Hemp Seed and Chia Overnight Oats
instructions: Mix oats, chia seeds, hemp seeds, and milk. Refrigerate overnight. Top with banana in the morning.

name: Sunflower Seed and Apple Yogurt Bowl
instructions: Mix yogurt with diced apple. Top with sunflower seeds and a drizzle of honey.

name: Kale and Avocado Power Smoothie
instructions: Blend kale, avocado, banana, and whole milk until smooth. Add chia seeds.

name: Pumpkin Seed and Oat Granola Bowl
instructions: Combine oats with pumpkin seeds. Serve with mixed berries and almond butter drizzle.

name: Dal Rice Bowl (Moong Dal and Basmati)
instructions: Cook moong dal with turmeric, garlic, and onion. Serve over basmati rice with a drizzle of ghee.

name: Rajma Chawal (Kidney Beans and Rice)
instructions: Simmer rajma with tomato, onion, garlic, and spices. Serve with basmati rice.

name: Chana Masala with Roti
instructions: Cook chickpeas with tomato, onion, garlic and masala spices. Serve with fresh roti.

name: Paneer Tikka Bowl with Brown Rice
instructions: Marinate paneer in yogurt and spices, grill or bake. Serve over brown rice with sliced veggies.

name: Hummus and Pita with Roasted Vegetables
instructions: Roast zucchini, red pepper, and carrot with olive oil. Serve with hummus and pita bread.

name: Mediterranean Quinoa Grain Bowl
instructions: Cook quinoa, top with feta, olives, cucumber, tomato, and a tahini drizzle.

name: Black Bean Burrito Bowl
instructions: Layer brown rice, black beans, avocado, tomato salsa, and red pepper in a bowl.

name: Pinto Bean Tacos with Avocado
instructions: Warm pinto beans with cumin and garlic. Fill corn tortillas with beans, avocado, and shredded cabbage.

name: Soba Noodle Bowl with Edamame and Miso
instructions: Cook soba noodles. Toss with miso-sesame dressing, edamame, and sliced cucumber.

name: Tempeh Bibimbap Style Bowl
instructions: Brown rice base topped with pan-fried tempeh, blanched spinach, shredded carrot, and miso drizzle.

name: Urad Dal with Basmati Rice
instructions: Cook urad dal with ginger, garlic, and tomato. Serve with basmati rice.

name: Masoor Dal Soup with Roti
instructions: Simmer masoor dal with turmeric and garlic until soft. Serve with fresh roti.

name: Tofu and Kale Stir-fry with Soba Noodles
instructions: Pan-fry tofu until golden. Stir-fry with kale and red pepper. Toss with cooked soba noodles.

name: Halloumi Salad with Chickpeas and Tahini
instructions: Grill halloumi, place on bed of spinach and chickpeas. Drizzle with tahini dressing.

name: Feta and Olive Mediterranean Wrap
instructions: Fill pita with spinach, feta, olives, cucumber, tomato, and drizzle with olive oil.

name: Chana Dal with Basmati Rice
instructions: Cook chana dal with cumin, ginger, and tomatoes. Serve over basmati rice.

name: Edamame Grain Bowl with Miso Dressing
instructions: Combine brown rice, edamame, kale, and carrot. Dress with miso-sesame sauce.

name: Avocado and Black Bean Salad
instructions: Mix black beans with avocado, tomato, corn, and lime juice. Season with cumin.

name: Tofu Nori Bowl
instructions: Layer basmati rice with pan-fried tofu, nori strips, edamame, and sesame miso sauce.

name: Grilled Salmon with Brown Rice and Broccoli
instructions: Season salmon fillet with herbs and grill 4-5 min per side. Serve with brown rice and steamed broccoli.

name: Mackerel with Roasted Sweet Potato and Kale
instructions: Roast sweet potato cubes at 200C. Bake mackerel fillet with lemon and herbs. Sauté kale.

name: Baked Cod with Zucchini and Quinoa
instructions: Bake cod with olive oil, garlic, and lemon. Serve with quinoa and roasted zucchini.

name: Sardine and Olive Mediterranean Plate
instructions: Arrange sardines on pita with olives, tomato, cucumber and a drizzle of tahini.

name: Chicken Curry with Basmati Rice
instructions: Sauté onion, garlic, ginger, add chicken pieces and curry spices, simmer until cooked. Serve with rice.

name: Tofu Stir-fry with Soba Noodles
instructions: Stir-fry tofu, broccoli, carrot, and kale in sesame oil. Toss with soba noodles and miso.

name: Tempeh Stir-fry with Brown Rice
instructions: Slice and fry tempeh with garlic, ginger, kale, and red pepper. Serve over brown rice.

name: Red Lentil Soup with Spinach
instructions: Simmer masoor dal with onion, garlic, tomato, and turmeric. Stir in spinach at end.

name: Salmon with Olive and Feta Salad
instructions: Grill salmon fillet. Serve with spinach, feta, olives, and cucumber tossed in olive oil.

name: Trout with Quinoa and Roasted Vegetables
instructions: Pan-sear trout with olive oil and herbs. Serve with quinoa and roasted zucchini and red pepper.

name: Rajma Masala with Brown Rice
instructions: Cook rajma with onion, tomato, and garam masala. Serve with brown rice.

name: Paneer and Spinach Curry (Palak Paneer)
instructions: Blend cooked spinach into sauce, add paneer cubes, spices, and simmer. Serve with roti.

name: Herring with Rye-style Pita and Cucumber Salad
instructions: Serve herring fillets with cucumber, onion, and dill on toasted pita.

name: Chickpea and Kale Stew
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic, add chickpeas, canned tomato, kale, and simmer 20 min.

name: Tuna with Avocado and Quinoa Bowl
instructions: Season tuna, sear 2 min per side. Serve over quinoa with avocado and cucumber.

name: Black Bean and Tofu Taco Bowl
instructions: Brown tofu and black beans with cumin. Serve over brown rice with avocado and tomato.

name: Cod with Spinach and Sweet Potato
instructions: Bake cod with olive oil and garlic. Serve with roasted sweet potato and sautéed spinach.

name: Edamame and Tofu Miso Bowl
instructions: Warm basmati rice with miso-glazed tofu and edamame. Top with nori and sesame.

name: Salmon with Broccoli and Edamame
instructions: Pan-sear salmon. Serve with steamed broccoli, edamame, and brown rice.

name: Pinto Bean and Tempeh Stew
instructions: Dice and brown tempeh. Add pinto beans, tomato, garlic, and simmer 20 min.

name: Greek Yogurt with Walnuts and Honey
instructions: Top Greek yogurt with crushed walnuts and a drizzle of honey.

name: Hummus with Carrot and Cucumber Sticks
instructions: Serve hummus with carrot sticks and cucumber slices.

name: Apple with Almond Butter
instructions: Slice apple and serve with almond butter for dipping.

name: Trail Mix with Seeds and Berries
instructions: Mix walnuts, pumpkin seeds, sunflower seeds, and dried berries.

name: Edamame with Sea Salt
instructions: Boil edamame 5 min. Drain and sprinkle with sea salt.

name: Peanut Butter and Apple Rice Cake
instructions: Spread peanut butter on roti or rice cake. Top with apple slices.

name: Chia Pudding Snack Cup
instructions: Mix chia seeds in milk, refrigerate. Serve topped with mixed berries.

name: Cottage Cheese with Cucumber and Seeds
instructions: Top cottage cheese with sliced cucumber and a sprinkle of sunflower seeds.

name: Hemp Seed Tahini Date Ball
instructions: Mix tahini, hemp seeds, oat bran, and pressed dates. Roll into balls and refrigerate.

name: Kitchari (Moong Dal and Rice Porridge)
instructions: Simmer moong dal with basmati rice, turmeric, and ginger until very soft. Add ghee if tolerated.

name: Bone Broth with Soft Steamed Vegetables
instructions: Heat bone broth, add finely diced carrot and zucchini. Simmer until very soft.

name: Plain Rice with Steamed Cod
instructions: Steam cod fillet over boiling water 10 min. Serve with plain basmati rice.

name: Banana Oat Porridge
instructions: Cook oats in water until very soft. Mash ripe banana and stir in. Serve warm.

name: Congee (Rice Porridge) with Ginger
instructions: Simmer basmati rice in 4x water with ginger slices for 25-30 min until porridge consistency.

name: Tofu Scramble with Spinach and Tomato
instructions: Crumble tofu into pan, add turmeric, spinach and tomato. Cook 8 min stirring often.

name: Almond Butter and Banana Oat Bars
instructions: Mix oats, almond butter, mashed banana, and chia seeds. Press into tin, bake 15 min at 180C.

name: Rajma Soup with Roti
instructions: Cook rajma with onion, garlic, tomato and spices into a thick soup. Serve with roti.

name: Falafel Bowl with Hummus and Salad
instructions: Form chickpeas into patties with garlic and herbs, pan-fry. Serve over hummus and salad.

name: Tempeh and Avocado Grain Bowl
instructions: Pan-fry tempeh slices. Serve on quinoa with avocado, spinach, and tomato.

name: Lentil and Sweet Potato Soup
instructions: Simmer lentils with diced sweet potato, garlic, cumin, and turmeric. Blend partially.

name: Tofu Lettuce Wraps with Miso Dipping Sauce
instructions: Crumble and season tofu with ginger. Wrap in lettuce leaves with carrot and cucumber. Dip in miso sauce.

name: Mexican Black Bean and Corn Burrito
instructions: Warm black beans with cumin. Fill corn tortillas with beans, avocado, and red pepper.

name: Tuna and Quinoa Salad Bowl
instructions: Flake tuna over cooked quinoa with spinach, cucumber, olives, and tahini dressing.

name: Mackerel and Avocado Open Sandwich
instructions: Flake mackerel over toasted pita bread. Top with avocado mash, cucumber, and tomato.

name: Salmon and Spinach Pasta
instructions: Cook soba noodles. Pan-sear salmon, flake over noodles with wilted spinach and garlic.

name: Chickpea Tikka Masala with Basmati
instructions: Cook chickpeas in rich tomato-onion masala sauce with spices. Serve over basmati rice.

name: Mackerel and Brown Rice Bowl
instructions: Grill mackerel fillet with ginger and miso glaze. Serve over brown rice with steamed spinach.

name: Tofu and Pumpkin Seed Quinoa Bowl
instructions: Bake tofu cubes. Serve over quinoa with roasted red pepper, kale, and pumpkin seeds.

name: Herring with Quinoa and Roasted Carrot
instructions: Pan-fry herring with herbs. Roast carrot and zucchini. Serve with quinoa.

name: Pinto Bean and Sweet Potato Curry
instructions: Simmer pinto beans and sweet potato in spiced tomato-onion curry. Serve with roti.

name: Sardine and Brown Rice Salad
instructions: Flake sardine over brown rice with spinach, tomato, cucumber, and tahini.

name: Mixed Berry and Walnut Smoothie
instructions: Blend mixed berries, banana, walnuts, and chia seeds with water until smooth.

name: Pumpkin Seed and Kale Chips Snack
instructions: Toss kale leaves in oil, bake until crispy. Serve with pumpkin seeds.

name: Avocado and Hemp Seed Dip with Veggie Sticks
instructions: Mash avocado with hemp seeds and lemon. Serve with carrot and cucumber sticks.

name: Oat Bran Energy Balls
instructions: Mix oat bran with almond butter, flax seeds, and banana. Roll into balls, refrigerate.

name: Black Bean and Avocado Stuffed Pita
instructions: Warm black beans with cumin. Stuff into pita with avocado, spinach, tomato, and cucumber.

name: Tempeh and Vegetable Miso Soup
instructions: Dissolve miso in warm broth. Add tempeh, tofu, seaweed, and spinach. Heat gently.
